nivo zeroes the vendor card's padding on purpose and hands the interior to the entry, which is why the entry must declare an inset.

consolidation.distinguishingFact: The second step is identical in both journeys down to the cooldown, and the cooldown is the part with a security consequence. Written into each panel it would be two copies of one sixty-second rule. Extracted as a sibling the pages mount, no block renders another block and the page keeps the only thing it owns - which step is showing.

A DIFFERENT DOMAIN ENTITY and a different slot identity: SignInPanel exchanges existing credentials for a session and holds two fields; this creates an account and holds three, the third existing only to be compared with the second. They also differ in what a submission MEANS - one opens a session, the other opens a challenge. They render similarly, which is the weakest signal on the list and never the verdict on its own.

It carries a constraint neither sibling has: it must not disclose whether an address is registered, in any state, which is why it has no unknown-address state and no provider shortcuts. Its slot identity differs too - one field, no password at the first step. Merging it into a variant prop would put a security rule behind a boolean.

contracts.why: Authentication is the route's only task, so its one bounded form sits at the visual centre instead of inheriting the dashboard's rail-and-main reading order.
The authentication form is one meaningful control group, so one card bounds it while the panel inside retains ownership of its typed form rhythm.
A surface read one control at a time is centred and narrow on purpose.
Authentication has exactly two entry blocks: OAuth closed by the OR divider above, and the credential form below.
The divider CLOSES the shortcut choice rather than merely separating it.
Controls repeat down one column as independently readable field or action units.
The hint belongs under the control it explains, because a reader reaches the hint after failing at the control.
Used for the step header too: its description slot carries the ADDRESS, which is why no step counter was minted.
A choice and the way out of it are pushed to opposite ends of one line.
A question and its answer read as one sentence.
Proposed by Plan; withdrawn after reading the reference's source. One Field with kind:"code" already expresses it and carries autocomplete=one-time-code.
Proposed by Plan; withdrawn. centred-title-pair already holds the pair, and the reference puts the address there instead of a step count.
